record.question: He lives in a world of _____.
record.explanation: Answer A: illusions. “A world of illusions” is a conventional expression for false appearances; it is the strongest collocation among the options. Independent check: “A world of illusions” means false appearances or beliefs; it is the natural collocation here. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/illusion. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
